what: Reference prompts for the three layered-design probes (Fable 5.2, 2026-11-14). Evidence runs only. "model" is the printed creature the prompt resembles; "hallmark" is a hand answer key for probe A, judged by reading; "inject" is the signature element for probe B and probe C.

prompts.hallmark: a web: a ranged restrain, the strand can be destroyed (the identity list calls this "snare")
prompts.inject: fires a line of tar that binds prey like a web
prompts.note: The word resolves to the CR 0 Spider, whose own rows are Spider Climb, Web Walker and Bite. The web action is on the Giant Spider. Report what the call does with the weaker block.

probeC.why: Model changed from the Spider: the CR 0 Spider has no web and a STR of 2; the Giant Spider is the nearest in CR and carries the Web

prompts.inject: a gaze that turns the living to stone

prompts.hallmark: drinks blood: a bite that drains and mends it
prompts.inject: drinks blood and is mended by it
prompts.note: No entry in the identity list of nine mechanics fits a drain; it can only arrive as a signature element.

probeC.why: The Vampire is CR 13 against an asked CR 8: the far-above case

prompts.name: Mother Ash
prompts.hallmark: deception: disguise, invisibility, a mimicked voice
prompts.note: A pinned twist on the Green Hag already exists in BLOCKS-bothways-2026-11-14.md to compare against.

probeC.baseline: run once without the flag on whatever donor the flagged run drew
probeC.why: Compare also with the pinned twist in BLOCKS-bothways-2026-11-14.md #05

prompts.hallmark: a rotting curse on its touch, or a glare that frightens
prompts.inject: a rotting touch that will not heal
prompts.note: Healing denial is on the brief's list of missing effects (item 5). A [gap] here is a finding, not a failure of the probe.

prompts.concept: a chapel bell-ringer's ghost that tolls for the dying
prompts.hallmark: possession, or a visage that frightens; the frame matters as much: it flies and is incorporeal

probeC.baseline: run once without the flag on whatever donor the flagged run drew
probeC.why: The frame matters most here: it flies and is incorporeal

prompts.note: CONTROL: the Ogre has no hallmark beyond its numbers. The model line must not make the call invent one.

revised: 2026-11-14, second version: a probeC block per prompt (model creature, donor to hold, baseline sheet). Probe C injects nothing.
